text:
maria: quick sync — ran a cross-config loadframe comparing kernel-swap+kv-prefetch vs baseline. hitting weird tail spikes when max_delay > 12ms under multi-tenant mix :thinking_face:
ajay: can you paste the exact config and which harness you used?
maria: used the replay harness with a sanitized production trace + a few synthetic microburst scenarios. config snippet below:
```
replay_harness --trace=trace_20260201.sanitized 
  --max_delay_ms=20 --batch_cap=128 --kernel_policy=adaptive-swap 
  --kv_prefetch=on --kv_prefetch_threshold=0.6
```
kevin: what are the hit rates and latencies? numbers will help.
maria: short summary: baseline (no prefetch, kernel=stable): p50 12ms, p95 38ms, p99 210ms, kv_hit 92%
  kernel-swap+prefetch: p50 11ms, p95 40ms, p99 420ms, kv_hit 78%
  microburst scenario (many tiny requests): p99 jumps to ~800ms when max_delay bumped to 20ms.
olivia: huh — prefetch reduced hit rate? sounds like we're evicting more useful prefixes during swapping. any flamegraphs?
maria: uploaded flamegraph: /run/1881234567/flame-1.svg (link). TL;DR: GC-like churn in KV cache meta when adaptive swap toggles kernels frequently. eviction churn correlates with kernel swap events.
ajay: could be timing: when kernel swap triggers, we pause/reshard KV index and in-flight prefix refs drop. try increasing kv_prefetch_threshold to 0.8 and lower swap sensitivity.
kevin: also try per-tenant delaycaps. small tenants getting collapsed into big batches during swap windows -> long tails. set delaycap to max(12ms, p50 * 3) per-tenant as an experiment.
maria: tried ajay's suggestion quickly: kv_prefetch_threshold 0.85 + kernel hysteresis 3s. result: p99 dropped to 260ms, kv_hit 86%. much better but still higher than baseline in multi-tenant mixes.
bench-bot: summary run finished: id=run-1881234567-1, config=adaptive-swap+prefetch_v2, p50=11.6ms, p95=36.8ms, p99=262.1ms, kv_hit=85.7%
olivia: nice. still want an apples vs apples baseline where we freeze kernel selection and only toggle prefetch. then inverse: freeze prefetch and toggle kernel. helps isolate which change causes eviction churn.
maria: agreed. planning: 1) controlled baseline runs (freeze kernel vs freeze prefetch) 2) per-tenant delaycap experiment 3) test higher batch_cap w/ adaptive swap turned off for 60s windows. can someone run (1) and (2) on the replay cluster?
ajay: I'll take (1) — will put a gate so kernel swap only allowed after 60s stable window.
kevin: I'll own (2) delaycap per-tenant and instrument per-tenant KV hit time series.
olivia: will help analyze traces and generate the microburst synthetic mix.
maria: cool — add results to /bench/1881234567/notes.md and ping here when done. thanks :pray:
